title: Control, Coordination and Heredity
summary: Grade 10: the nervous system and reflexes, hormones in plants and animals, Mendel’s laws and how sex is determined.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Nerves and hormones coordinate the body, while genes passed from parents create patterns of inheritance.

conceptual: How are nervous and hormonal control different?
How can two tall parents have a short child?
debatable: Should parents be allowed to know a baby's sex before birth? (It is illegal in India: why?)
